text_block_list.text:
After hearing that some of
Matikanefukukitaru's
choreography is
inspired by one of her dreams, I
go to
take a look...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You've finally come, Trainer! I
shall now
perform my lucky dance, so
keep your eyes on me
at all times!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: First off, I slowly crawl across the floor...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
And then I gradually raise my right leg
up toward
the sky! Hi-yaap!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
So, what do you think of my wondrous
dance
moves?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: I bet you feel luckier already!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list:
Was that some kind of nouveau contemporary
dance?

text_block_list.text: Hmph! No, it was not!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
But whatever, it's fine if you don't
understand! I'm
sure you felt our luck
increase, though, right?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: I know how you feel. I was at a loss for words once I finished the choreography. I was that emotional!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Anyways, I'd like to perform this in a
concert as
soon as possible!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I admire her guts, but I'm not sure the
lively stage
of a winning concert is the
right place to
showcase this particular
dance...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Sure, it can't hurt to try!

text_block_list.text: Uh, yeah, I sure hope it wouldn't hurt!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I'm a little shocked! But strangely
enough, I feel a
little excited about this
now!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I'll keep the moves just as they were

communicated to me so as not to
extinguish my
heart's blazing flame!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I'll put on the most dazzling performance
of the
whole concert!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I need to go review my dream for some
extra
practice! Night night!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Hm! Energetic, you say?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Argh... I guess I should avoid
unnecessary
movements. If I cut that part
out and change
some things around...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh? Oh ho! Let's give this a shot!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Boom shakalaka! ♪ Wassup y'all! It's
your girl,
Matikanefukukitaru! I want this
bonfire lit, so
lemme hear you clap!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Believers, put your hands to the sky!

Non-believers, listen up and let me open
your
third eye! Whoop whoop!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Her hip-hop-inspired dance isn't quite
what I
expected, but it certainly is more
energetic.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I can't wait to show this to
everyone!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
A very enthusiastic practice session is all
it takes
to liven up her dance skills.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After a quick nap, she incorporates even
more
"wondrous" dance moves into the
choreography.
Her finished product is
quite dynamic.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
